title: الأَرْقَامُ العَرَبِيَّةُ
blocks: ## Use the chapter at the depth you need
- Convert between Arabic and Western figures.
- Use figures in times, prices and dates.
[callout] Visual warning: Arabic ٠ is the zero, while Arabic ٥ is the five. Learners often confuse these at first.
## Arabic text runs right to left, but multi-digit figures keep their place value
The hundreds digit is ١, the tens digit is ٢ and the units digit is ٣.
The number still means one hundred and twenty-three.
[callout] Do not reverse the digits: ١٢ means 12, not 21.
TABLE: Western | Arabic figures | Use // 12 | ١٢ | age, quantity // 47 | ٤٧ | price, bus number // 105 | ١٠٥ | room number, quantity // 2027 | ٢٠٢٧ | year
[callout] Functional reading: in telephone numbers, codes and room numbers, digits are often read one by one rather than as a full cardinal number.
